VERSATILE & DECORATIVE: Sticks Multi Hook helps keep your home organized while simultaneously adding a modern decorative touch. Use Sticks to hang your daily essentials like coats, hats, scarves, purses, umbrellas, bathrobes and more

UNIQUE & STRONG: Made of molded polypropylene, the sculptural design of Sticks Multi Hook garment rack looks at first glance like a modern piece of art, until you notice that some of the “sticks” flip down to become hooks for hanging (each supporting up to 5 lbs. )

description: Keeping entryways with all those coats and accessories neat and organized is always a challenge, especially in small spaces. Transform this area into a tidy and stylish space with a modern coat rack that doubles as wall art. Introducing Sticks Multi Hook by Umbra Sticks Multi Wall Hook is a sculptural and yet functional wall mountable coat rack that will provide you with ample hanging space in virtually every area of your home, office or dorm room. This versatile and decorative coat hanger accommodates all your personal hanging needs for items such as coats, scarves, purses, umbrellas, bathrobes, towels, accessories or even light weighted cleaning tools like brooms, sweepers creating a clean, seamless profile that’s great for small spaces. Designed to support even heavier items, each flip-hook will hold up to 5 lbs. , making it an ideal solution for home organization. Sticks Wall Mounted Coat Rack measures 19 1/2 x 7 1/4 x 1-inch and comes complete with mounting hardware making installation quick and easy. Start organizing and decorating your home with this eye-catching modern design by ordering Sticks Multi Hook from Umbra today.
